title: Prospective Context-Indexed Causal Fiber Field, Pre-Intervention Context Sufficiency, Minimal Conditioning-Basis Identification, Cross-World Congruence Restoration, Held-Out Context Transport & Explanation-Scope Calibration

parent_authority.boundary: The same F0 intervention-response fiber carried different ROOT_CHANGE labels across fresh contexts, including a reversal within Berserk across two positions.

objective: Identify the smallest frozen set of pre-intervention context coordinates for which equal P1 F0 fibers regain deterministic ROOT_CHANGE congruence on fresh discovery environments, then test the resulting partial causal field on target-blind scoped held-out contexts from a distinct opening-depth source and expose the result as a reusable certificate tool.

formal_object.context_index: C_S(r) for a frozen coordinate subset S
formal_object.congruence: K_S(ri)=K_S(rj) implies ROOT_CHANGE(ri)=ROOT_CHANGE(rj) over the tested support
formal_object.field: L_S : (F0,C_S) partial-> {ROOT_CHANGE,NO_ROOT_CHANGE}; unseen cells return ABSTAIN_UNSEEN_CONTEXT
formal_object.interpretation: A query-specific operational causal field, not metaphysical event identity or universal causal transport.

context_measurement.board: python-chess on the frozen FEN before singleton intervention
context_measurement.search: unablated parent search and P32 semantic-use trace only
context_measurement.event: candidate's parent-trace attributes before singleton removal
context_measurement.p24_return_to_origin: parent_activity_bucket, parent_qshare_bucket and parent_class_balance are the event-trace analogue of P24 TOTAL/Q_SHARE/IMBALANCE coordinates

corpus.event_sampler: Group parent events by scope×semantic-class×ply-bucket; sort addresses within strata; lexical-stratum round-robin until eight distinct events.

discovery_basis_court.minimality: Enumerate every portable subset by increasing cardinality. Retain every admissible subset at the first cardinality with any admissible subset; do not select a unique basis using discovery targets.
discovery_basis_court.engine_specific_lane: Apply the same vocabulary within each engine as a descriptive comparison; engine-specific bases cannot replace the pooled cross-engine court.
discovery_basis_court.no_portable_basis: Run an architecture-indexed diagnostic search only; max total cardinality 4, at most one architecture coordinate, at least one portable coordinate. This lane cannot earn architecture-free transport.

heldout_firewall.execution: Held-out singleton jobs emit separate profile and target artifacts.
heldout_firewall.target_artifact: Sealed separately and never downloaded by scope-selection job.
heldout_firewall.scope_selection: Among discovery-minimal portable bases, maximize target-blind seen-cell coverage on held-out profiles; then covered-engine count; then covered-position count; then lexical basis ID.

heldout_transport_gate.condition: Only covered held-out profiles whose (F0,context) signature existed in discovery receive a prediction.
pass: scope gate was sealed before targets were opened
heldout_transport_gate.abstention: Unseen signatures are ABSTAIN_UNSEEN_CONTEXT and are not errors or evidence of non-causality.
heldout_transport_gate.failure: Any covered contradiction falsifies the selected context basis for the frozen transport support.

forbidden: claim that abstention means no cause
claim that context coordinates are uniquely true causal variables

implementation_object.utility_goal: A researcher can feed exact-event/F0/profile packets to a frozen field and receive CERTIFIED/ABSTAIN/COLLISION evidence without rerunning the research court.

literature.work: Peters, Bühlmann & Meinshausen (2016), Causal Inference by Using Invariant Prediction
literature.role: Conditional invariance across environments motivates minimal conditioning-basis search.

literature.work: Pearl & Bareinboim (2011), Transportability of Causal and Statistical Relations
literature.role: Transport requires explicit statements of cross-environment differences/commonalities; context basis is treated as a licensing condition.

literature.work: VanderWeele & Hernán (2013), Causal Inference Under Multiple Versions of Treatment
literature.role: A single coarse intervention/fiber label may hide causally distinct versions.
Source-grounded exogenous heterogeneity motivates the secondary architecture-anchor lane.

literature.work: Sutter et al. (2025), The Non-Linear Representation Dilemma
literature.role: Anti-vacuity: constrain context vocabulary and alignment capacity before outcomes.

literature.work: Duarte & Solus (2026), Representation of context-specific causal models with observational and interventional data
literature.role: Formal comparison point for context-specific interventional structure; not used as an authority override.
Interventional commutation remains the abstraction standard; P2 narrows authority by context.

claim_ceiling: A selected basis is finite-support and query-specific; it is not the unique true causal context.
Target-blind held-out scope calibration may choose among already-minimal discovery bases using coverage only; it may not inspect held-out targets.
Architecture descriptors are secondary diagnostics and cannot make a failed portable field count as architecture-free transport.
Unseen context signatures cause abstention, not negative causal conclusions.
No transport beyond the frozen books, engine commits, history procedure, frontier and 80k-node measurement search is authorized.
No strategy, cognition, human intent or population prevalence claim is authorized.
